text_block_list.text: HAH!
HI-YAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wham!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear a lot of strange noises coming
from the
arcade center, so I poke my
head in to see what's
going on...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Darn. I'm still so far from beating
the top
score.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I won't give up, though. No matter the challenge, I will complete this noble mission!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will surely reign supreme over this
boxing
machine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, hello there. And of course I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess must be strong. This is just
one part of
my princess martial arts
training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes. A princess stands equal to a
prince. She
must fight by his side and
even save him on
occasion.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For that, she must have two
things—strength and skills... Which
reminds me! I have something to
ask of
you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wish to get the top score on this boxing
machine
but am having trouble. Do you
have any pointers
you can share?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! There's only one way to
defeat a
mighty foe who refuses to fall
no matter how
much you punch them...
choice_data_list: Let's make the next one our final ...
How about picturing the opponent y...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And that is to steel yourself and give
them a good
sucker punch right in the
kisser!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Watch and see... this is the ultimate
power of a
princess! Hiii-yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Shining Princess Explosiiiive Fist!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wa-bam!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess lets loose a powerful
right straight while declaring the move's
name. The punch lands and breaks the
record with flying
colors!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's a good point. I can't truly feel in
the
moment if I'm punching without a
true target.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... Brace yourself, my
dear prince!
Here I come!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course. What is a princess if she
cannot best a
prince with her fist? Now
witness my true power!
choice_data_list: You're gonna take down the Prince?!
You're going to defeat the Prince?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A princess challenging a prince. Now
that's a new one... I'm sure Kawakami
Princess will become the
kind of princess
she dreams of being.
